theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_graph_measure_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → (∀ (A : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ ball 0 s → Measurable g → ∫⁻ v in A, g (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) ≤ ∫⁻ x in (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' A, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, t < s → μHE[n] ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' closedBall (0 : Euclid n) t) ≠ ∞
